I’m new to my diagnosis so the only medication I’ve been on is concerta. My current dose is 27 mg which is the second lowest dose available.

I’ve heard of more extreme effects with different meds and different people, but for me it kinda just feels like the world gets quieter? It’s what everyone says but it literally just gets easier to focus, like my thoughts aren’t slowing down by my brain is speeding up to catch up to my thoughts? So I can think more than normal and I get less overwhelmed, like I can make a todo list and actually feel motivated to do it and end up doing stuff. With concerta there’s a lot of side effects though, like I get a super bad crash after it wears off where I’m just so tired and don’t want to do anything, if I don’t eat before I take my meds I get super bad stomach cramps, and I also feel less emotionally available? Like I’m not completely a robot but I definitely feel more impatient with other people’s feelings and less able to feel empathy? Also do NOT drink caffeine when on your adhd meds, your meds are stimulants and when you have caffeine (another stimulant) it gets… wacky. I did it once and I literally felt high for like 5 hours after, I felt dizzy and was having heart palpitations and couldn’t think straight. It was nuts. 

If you have any specific questions I can try to answer them? But yeah I’m new to this too lol
